summary.text: Rolf Olsen is a Republican state representative from Maine who has represented District 86 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia, which lists him as Rolf Olsen Jr., gives his profession as insurance agent.

paragraphs.text: Rolf Olsen Jr. earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Maine in 1979, and his career experience includes working as an insurance agent.
He assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 3, 2024, succeeding Jessica Fay.
